name: enclosure_sheep
description: Evaluate VLM ability to reason about spatial enclosure in procedurally generated 3D fence-and-sheep scenes by counting sheep that cannot escape, detecting escape routes, finding the most populated partition cell, and estimating fence repairs.

easy.note: Simple single fences, few sheep, clear separation

medium.note: Nested fences, gaps/gates, moderate sheep count

hard.note: Complex multi-fence partitions, many sheep, subtle gaps
